use: Two expression frames per supplied species; split into independent transparent WebP assets.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: two-frame game character expression sprite sheet for Task Monster. The supplied image is the edit target: forest-sprout. Produce ONE wide horizontal transparent sprite sheet with exactly TWO equal square cells side by side, each showing the same full-body character at the same scale, fully inside its own cell with 8% transparent margin; never cross the middle boundary. LEFT CELL: hurt but determined, eyebrows angled inward, slightly narrowed eyes, small tense mouth, one sweat drop; body upright. RIGHT CELL: very low health, exhausted drooping eyelids, worried wobbly mouth, two sweat drops, arms/wings/leaves droop slightly. Keep the exact character identity, body colors, glossy highlights, thick dark-purple outlines, existing crown if present, belly details, appendages and silhouette. Preserve cute friendly tone. Change expression and small pose details only. Keep both characters centered in their equal cells on a genuinely transparent background. No text, labels, border, panels, extra characters or background. This is a two-frame sprite sheet, NOT a scene.
